findings.text: non-blocking: the superseded-head case was weakened from an exact `duty["kind"] == "review-missing"` to `"review-awaiting-promotion" not in kinds` plus `REVIEW_RUN_ID not in str(duties)`. A regression that yields no review duty at all for a superseded head now passes both assertions, so the test no longer holds the reading its docstring states — that the run is owed a review of its new head.
